trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: The Standard trial needs a card. You won’t be charged until the trial ends, and you can cancel before then. Each organisation can have one trial.

change.a: Yes. Upgrades apply straight away and are charged pro rata. Downgrades apply at the end of your billing period, and nothing is deleted.

cancel.a: You keep access until the end of the period you paid for. After that your account becomes read-only: you can still view, export and download your work.

newSignIn.body: Your PostMind Studio account was just signed in to from {device}.
newSignIn.note: If this was you, you do not need to do anything. If not, sign out that session and change your password.

invite.subject: {inviterName} invited you to {organisationName} on PostMind Studio
invite.heading: Join {organisationName} on PostMind Studio
invite.body: {inviterName} invited you to join {organisationName} as {role, select, owner {an owner} admin {an admin} publisher {a publisher} creator {a creator} viewer {a viewer} other {a member}}. Accept the invitation to start working together on videos.
invite.note: The invitation expires in 7 days. Sign in with this email address to accept it. If you were not expecting it, you can ignore this email.

ownershipTransferred.subject: You are now the owner of {organisationName}
ownershipTransferred.heading: You are now the owner of {organisationName}
ownershipTransferred.body: {newOwnerName} made you the owner of {organisationName} on PostMind Studio. As owner you manage billing and can delete the organisation.

trialEnding.subject: Your {planName} trial ends on {trialEndsAt, date, long}
trialEnding.heading: Your trial ends soon
trialEnding.body: Your {planName} trial ends on {trialEndsAt, date, long}. After that, your plan continues and the card on file is charged. To change or cancel, open billing settings before then.

paymentFailed.subject: Your payment failed
paymentFailed.heading: We could not take your payment
paymentFailed.body: The latest payment for your PostMind Studio plan failed. Please update your payment details. If the payment still fails by {graceEndsAt, date, long}, your organisation becomes read-only until it is paid.

paymentActionRequired.subject: Your payment needs confirming
paymentActionRequired.heading: Confirm your payment
paymentActionRequired.body: Your bank asked for extra confirmation before it can complete the payment for your PostMind Studio plan. Open the invoice to confirm it.

subscriptionChanged.subject: Your plan is now {planName}
subscriptionChanged.heading: Your plan was changed
subscriptionChanged.body: Your organisation is now on the {planName} plan. Your usage limits and features have been updated.

subscriptionCanceled.subject: Your subscription was cancelled
subscriptionCanceled.heading: Your subscription was cancelled
subscriptionCanceled.body: Your PostMind Studio subscription is cancelled. You keep full access until {endsAt, date, long}; after that your organisation becomes read-only. You can subscribe again at any time.

topupReceipt.subject: Your top-up is ready: {packName}
topupReceipt.heading: Top-up added
topupReceipt.body: Thank you. The {packName} top-up has been added to your organisation and is ready to use. Stripe sends the receipt separately.

accountDeletionScheduled.subject: Your account will be deleted
accountDeletionScheduled.heading: Your account will be deleted
accountDeletionScheduled.body: You asked us to delete your PostMind Studio account. You have been signed out everywhere, and your account and its data will be permanently deleted on {deleteAt, date, long}.
accountDeletionScheduled.note: If you did not ask for this, contact support before that date.

orgDeletionScheduled.subject: {organisationName} will be deleted
orgDeletionScheduled.heading: {organisationName} will be deleted
orgDeletionScheduled.body: The organisation {organisationName} was deleted in PostMind Studio. Its projects, videos and connections will be permanently removed on {deleteAt, date, long}.
orgDeletionScheduled.note: If this was a mistake, contact support before that date.

dataExportReady.subject: Your data export is ready
dataExportReady.heading: Your data export is ready
dataExportReady.body: The export you requested from PostMind Studio is ready to download. The download link works until {expiresAt, date, long}.

monthPlanned.subject: Your month is planned: {postCount, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} from {startDate, date, long} to {endDate, date, long}
monthPlanned.heading: Your month is planned
monthPlanned.body: {postCount, plural, one {# post is} other {# posts are}} scheduled from {startDate, date, long} to {endDate, date, long}. Each one publishes at its time unless you change or remove it first. {needsAttention, plural, one {# post needs your attention.} other {# posts need your attention.}}

unsubscribe.confirmBody: You will no longer receive emails about “{kind}” for this organisation. You will still see these notifications in PostMind Studio.
unsubscribe.doneBody: You will no longer receive emails about “{kind}” for this organisation. You can turn them back on in your notification preferences in PostMind Studio.
unsubscribe.invalidBody: The unsubscribe link is incomplete or has been changed. Use the link in your latest email, or change your notification preferences in PostMind Studio.

preferences.description: Choose what reaches you, in the app and by email.
preferences.suppressed: We can’t email you: messages to your address bounced or were marked as spam. Contact support to turn email back on.

legal.warning: Sign-up is not blocked, but these documents are still placeholders.

legal.fillInHint: Fill in the [[…]] details (company name, number, address and contacts) in content/legal/en-GB, as listed in content/legal/FILL-IN.md, then have a solicitor review the texts.

detail.noMemberships: Not a member of any organisation.
detail.actionsHint: Every action needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.

ban.title: Ban {name}?
ban.body: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until the ban is lifted.

unban.title: Lift the ban on {name}?
unban.body: They can sign in again straight away.

sessions.title: Sign {name} out everywhere?
sessions.body: Every browser and device they are signed in on is signed out.

twoFactor.title: Reset two-step verification for {name}?
twoFactor.body: Only after checking who they are another way. Their authenticator and backup codes stop working and they set it up again.

impersonate.title: View Studio as {name}?
impersonate.body: A 30-minute, read-only session with a banner. Everything you open is audited.

new.title: Plan my month
new.description: Studio drafts a month of videos and slideshows from your website, brand kit and past posts. You edit the list, then everything is generated and scheduled: each post goes out at its time unless you change or remove it first.
new.startHint: The first day of the plan. It starts on your next free day unless you pick another.
new.postsPerDayOption: {count, plural, one {# a day} other {# a day}}
new.useMyTimesHint: Your calendar has {count, plural, one {# posting time} other {# posting times}} a week; a plan uses at most 4 a day.
new.noPostingTimes: No posting times yet. Set them on the calendar to use them here.
new.mixHint: Slideshows are quicker and cheaper to make; videos use AI clips and a voice-over.
new.estimate: Up to {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} over {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
new.costHint: Typical cost to make: about {video} a video and up to {slideshow} a slideshow.

problems.accountRequired: Choose the account each platform posts to. Platforms without a connected account are made but not posted.

noBusiness.title: Choose a business first
noBusiness.description: A month plan belongs to one business.

new.noAccountsNotice: No connected accounts: the posts are made and saved for your review instead of being scheduled. Connect an account to have them posted at their times.
new.someWithoutAccount: Made but not posted automatically (no connected account): {platforms}.

hold.kill_switch: Generation is paused by Studio for now. Your posts carry on automatically when it resumes.
hold.cost_cap: Paused: this month’s spending limit has been reached. It carries on when the limit resets or you add a top-up.
hold.daily_limit: Paused until tomorrow: today’s limit for month plans has been reached. The rest carry on automatically.

drafting.title: Drafting your month
drafting.body: Claude is writing your posts from your business details. This usually takes a minute or two.

editor.costEstimate: Estimated cost to make: about {typical} (at most {max}).
editor.allowanceUse: Uses {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} of this month’s allowance.
editor.reviewWindow: Once generated, each post publishes at its time unless you change or remove it before then. You get one email when your month is ready.
editor.regenerateAria: Write a new topic instead of “{title}”
editor.generateConfirmTitle: Generate and schedule {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}?
editor.generateConfirmBody: Studio makes every post and schedules it at its time. Each one publishes on its own unless you change or remove it before then. You get one email when your month is ready.
editor.discardConfirmBody: The draft and its posts are thrown away. Nothing has been made or scheduled yet.
editor.addWhenHint: Inside the plan’s dates, at most 4 posts a day.
editor.noAccountsWindow: This plan has no connected account, so each post is made and saved for your review; nothing is posted automatically. You get one email when your month is ready.
editor.generateConfirmBodyNoAccounts: Studio makes every post and saves it for your review. Nothing is posted automatically because the plan has no connected account: publish each post from its page. You get one email when your month is ready.

view.heldNote: {count, plural, one {# post was} other {# posts were}} held by the safety check and will not be published. Open one to see why, then edit or remove it.
view.reviewWindow: Each post publishes at its time. Until then you can open it to edit it, swap it for another topic or remove it.
view.cancelConfirm: Every post that has not gone out yet is cancelled and its time freed. This cannot be undone.
view.swapped: Topic swapped: the new post is being made
view.removeConfirm: Its post is cancelled and the time is freed. The rest of the plan carries on.
